title: Hourtag
subtitle: Hourtag is a full-featured time tracking and work management SaaS for teams and freelancers to manage time, projects, and productivity with precision.
description:
Hourtag is a modern time tracking and work management SaaS designed to streamline how individuals and teams manage their productivity. Built with a scalable architecture using NestJS, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, it provides a seamless experience for logging work hours, managing projects, and tracking tasks across organizations. Whether you're a freelancer managing client deliverables or a project manager overseeing distributed teams, Hourtag empowers you to track time effectively and stay accountable.

The platform offers key features such as real-time timers, task-based tracking, team views, and detailed activity logs. Its clean UI allows for effortless interaction, while powerful backend APIs ensure data integrity and fast performance. Integrated with AWS and deployed on a fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure, Hourtag ensures reliability and uptime even during high usage periods.

Hourtag was engineered with developer experience and scalability in mind — including modular code structure, consistent domain modeling, and secure role-based access. Its integration capabilities and clean RESTful APIs make it easy to connect with third-party invoicing or reporting tools. It's not just a tracker — it's a foundation for productive work culture.

title: Hyteno System
subtitle: Hyteno is a multi-tenant SaaS for restaurant businesses, enabling order management, website hosting, and customer management on a scalable microservices platform.
description:
Hyteno System is a powerful SaaS platform built for restaurant chains and food service providers. It empowers businesses to manage orders, host branded websites, handle CRM, and automate communication flows — all within a single multi-tenant environment. The backend, built using NestJS and PostgreSQL, is fully modular, secure, and built to scale horizontally across regions.

Hyteno's microservices architecture is orchestrated using Docker containers and deployed on AWS ECS for scalable and fault-tolerant infrastructure. RabbitMQ handles async event queues like order updates, notifications, and user onboarding. Redis is used for caching and real-time data access, ensuring fast performance even under heavy load.

From a product perspective, Hyteno offers an admin dashboard for managing tenants (restaurants), customizable modules for each client, and dynamic content delivery across multiple touchpoints (web, mobile, API). With its seamless integration capabilities, it allows small restaurants to become digitally autonomous, and large food chains to standardize operations across locations. Hyteno is not just a platform — it's a scalable digital OS for food enterprises.
